title: Dependency-Ordered Plans
learning_objectives: Represent a plan as a dependency graph
Topologically sort tasks with Kahn's algorithm
Detect cycles and group tasks into parallel stages
hints: Build `dependents[d].append(t)` for each t and each d in deps[t]; `indeg[t] = len(deps[t])`.
`ready = [t for t in deps if indeg[t] == 0]; heapq.heapify(ready)`.
Stages: loop taking `sorted(t for t in remaining if all deps done)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Use a min-heap of ready tasks so the smallest ready task goes first.
If not all tasks were output, raise ValueError('cycle detected').
A stage is every task whose dependencies are all in earlier stages.
Every dependency must be a key of deps.
